thread:
maya (PM): Quick sync — we need a concise launch gating checklist for the tool/function-calling API. Customers are asking for stable schemas and predictable failure semantics. Who can own the final list?
ben (Eng): I can draft engineering gates. Main ones I care about: schema versioning, backward compat, clear error envelope, and deterministic fallback to non-tool path.
lena (API): We also need SDK compatibility guarantees and a deprecation policy. Customers will expect stable call/result shapes for 6+ months.
sam (Infra): Observability: token-level cost, per-tool latency percentiles, and failed-call rates per region. Without those metrics we shouldn't go GA.
josh (Research): Add quality telemetry — output correctness vs eval prompts. If a tool call changes model behavior we need regression alerts.
maya (PM): Good. Proposed high-level gates: 1) Schema stability + migrations documented, 2) Telemetry baseline + alerts, 3) SDK adapters + migration guide, 4) Rollout plan with canary & auto-fallback, 5) Hostage test with top 5 customers. Thoughts? :eyes: 
ben (Eng): Add compatibility: when schema_version increments, runtime must accept older envelopes for at least N months. Also require a shim layer in SDKs: older payload => server normalizes to current internal format.
lena (API): For the migration guide, we should include a minimal "call envelope" example and a list of non-goals. Example to include in docs: 
```json
{
  "tool": {"name": "send_email", "schema_version": "1.0"},
  "args": {"to": "user@example.com", "subject": "Welcome"}
}
```
ben (Eng): +1. Also define error envelope: 
- code (string), message (string), retriable (bool), fallback_action (string|null).
This lets SDKs decide to retry, escalate, or convert to a model-only response.
sam (Infra): Rollout plan: internal canary (10% traffic) -> pilot customers (config opt-in) -> GA. Must include automated rollback triggers on latency spike (>30% P95) or error-rate (>2% per minute). release-bot: Deploy scheduled: canary window 24h, pilot window 7d.
josh (Research): For quality gating, we should have a small eval harness that runs a curated prompt set through both current and candidate tool paths and reports delta in correctness + hallucination score. Fail if hallucination increases by >1.5x.
maya (PM): Good metric thresholds. Let's formalize the launch criteria doc: 
- Functional: tool call success rate >= 99% in canary; fallback behaves predictably.
- Performance: P95 latency within 1.5x of model-only baseline for first-party tools.
- Quality: eval-delta <= 1.5x hallucination, no regressions on top 100 prompts.
- Observability: per-tool telemetry + SDK traces + customer-facing logs available.
- Docs: migration guide + sample code + deprecation policy.
ben (Eng): One more: define the consumer contract for partial success (tool returned partial data). How do we surface partials vs model hallucination? Propose standardized result wrapper: 
```json
{
  "result": {"status": "partial|ok|error", "payload": {...}},
  "model_message": "..."
}
```
lena (API): Agree. We'll require tool authors to mark fields as optional/required in the schema so clients can decide what to do with partials. Also add a "confidence" field for structured outputs.
sam (Infra): Telemetry details: we'll emit metrics: tool.call.count, tool.call.failure.count, tool.call.latency.p50/p95, tool.call.fallback.count, tool.schema.version. All tagged by customer_id, region, model. We need retention policy for these metrics (90 days for GA by default).
josh (Research): For the eval harness, we can automate daily runs during pilot and send regression alerts to the product-alerts channel. That should catch silent regressions.
maya (PM): Owners: Ben -> eng gates & SDK shims; Lena -> API contract + docs; Sam -> infra telemetry & rollout ops; Josh -> quality harness. I'll own customer pilot coordination. Please add the checklist items to the PR template.
ben (Eng): I'll open the PR today. Will include a sample shim code snippet and the error envelope schema.
lena (API): I'll draft the migration guide and a short FAQ for customers.
sam (Infra): I'll create the dashboard and the automated alerts. release-bot: Canary scheduled for 1715600000 UTC.
maya (PM): Final ask — define a single compatibility promise sentence to put in the docs. Draft: "We guarantee stable call/result shapes for minor schema versions (x.y) for 6 months; major versions may require migration." Reactions?
ben (Eng): Sounds reasonable, but add "unless critical security bug" clause.
lena (API): +1 to the clause. Also specify who approves a major version bump (API WG + Security).
maya (PM): Great — looks like we have alignment. Action items summarized in PR. Thanks everyone :rocket:
